# Carelink Psykiatri Kolding

Carelink Psykiatri Kolding is a private psychiatric provider that appears repeatedly in the Danish ADHD Database's 2024 quality report, which tracks treatment outcomes for children, young people, and adults diagnosed with ADHD. The provider is one of several private actors — alongside [[carelink-psykiatri-viborg|Carelink Psykiatri Viborg]] and [[carelink-psykiatri-roskilde|Carelink Psykiatri Roskilde]] — whose performance is benchmarked against national development goals across a range of clinical indicators [^src1].

The clearest documented finding about Carelink Psykiatri Kolding concerns Indicator 4, which measures the share of treatment courses for children and young people under 18 where a coordinating network meeting was held within 90 days of treatment start. Nationally, this indicator has stayed far below the 90% development goal, averaging only 20% across Denmark, and the steering group behind the ADHD Database has pointed to pressure on specialized psychiatry and primary care, geographic challenges, and competing priorities as barriers to improvement [^src1]. Within this picture, Carelink Psykiatri Kolding recorded 7 out of 141 courses meeting the target, a completion rate of 5% (confidence interval 2–10%) [^src1]. This placed it at the upper end of the private-actor range reported in the database, with private providers spanning from 1% (Carelink Psykiatri Viborg) to 5% (Carelink Psykiatri Kolding) [^src1].

On a separate indicator — the report's later section on Indicator 5 (psychoeducation, with a national completion rate of only 33%) and Indicator 6 (ADHD medication use, nationally at 68%) — Carelink Psykiatri Kolding is recorded with 0 out of 141 courses meeting the measured target (0%, confidence interval 0–3%) [^src2].

Further along in the report, covering results on medication use within 120 days of treatment start and educational outcomes for young people with ADHD (Indicators 6, 7a, and 7b), Carelink Psykiatri Kolding shows a markedly different profile: 127 out of 141 patients recorded, with a 0% figure in one column and 90% (confidence interval 84–94%) in another [^src3]. This aligns with a broader claim in the report that among private hospitals' patients, between 86% and 100% are treated with ADHD medication [^src3], placing Carelink Psykiatri Kolding within that high-treatment range.

For adults, the database introduces new indicators in 2024. Indicator 10, measuring whether adult patients' social support needs were assessed within 120 days of treatment start, shows Carelink Psykiatri Kolding at 0 out of 3 courses (0%, confidence interval 0–71%) — a result reported for the first time nationally, where overall completion also lags the 90% goal, sitting at 37% nationally and 14–52% regionally [^src4]. By contrast, Indicator 11, which tracks whether adult patients are on ADHD medication within 120 days of starting a treatment package (also newly reported in 2024 following the database's expansion to adult patients), shows Carelink Psykiatri Kolding at 3 out of 3 courses, a 100% completion rate (confidence interval 29–100%) [^src5].

Taken together, these figures show a private provider whose performance varies sharply by indicator — near the top among private actors for coordinating network meetings, yet showing zero completion on some psychoeducation and social-support-assessment measures, alongside strong or full completion on medication-related indicators.
